What? This is a big battle!
Leave me alone!

I’m not a Trainer.
But if you look one in the eyes,
prepare to battle.
Hey, kiddo!
How in the world can you be so
oblivious to my eye-catching house?
Hold it right there!
When you follow that path up north,
you will see Mr. Pokémon’s house.
But before you go, let me finish what
I have to say.
Do you...have any Apricorns?
Apricorn trees bear fruit once a day.
I have one of those trees, too!
Apricorns are really something.
You can make Poké Balls and
other things.
They are quite useful.
I have a feeling this is meant to be,
because I have something for you!
With that Apricorn Box, you can carry
so many Apricorns.
You’ll be a decent Apricorn collector!

South to Cherrygrove City
Mr. Pokémon’s House
Straight Ahead!
Trainer Tips
No stealing other people’s Pokémon!
Poké Balls are to be thrown only at
wild Pokémon!
Oh! You’re wearing the Running Shoes.
They make you feel like you are flying,
don’t they?
But beware of wild Pokémon and
Trainers!
When you run, the noise will
attract them.
Oh, hello. Mr. Pokémon said he was
expecting a young trainer to arrive...
Is your name {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}, by any chance?
I see. I guess you are the trainer
Mr. Pokémon was expecting!
My name is Cynthia. I’m a Pokémon
Trainer who hails from Sinnoh.
Cynthia: Tell me, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}, have you
heard a story that tells the tale of
the Legendary Trainer?
Cynthia: You haven’t? I’ll briefly
explain. The story tells the tale of
how a trainer travels the lands of
Johto and Kanto, catching all the
Pokémon known to mankind. He captures
the most basic of Pokémon, and even
the most mythical of Pokémon, to
eventually come face to face with
the one who the Pokémon call god...
Cynthia: The archaeology in the Johto
region appears to back the existence
of this story. It’s interesting, to
be sure.
Cynthia: Thank you for listening to
me, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}. You know, you remind me
of a trainer I knew from Sinnoh...
You may not know it yet, but I think
you are capable of great things.
In fact, I’d like to help you reach
your maximum potential!
Cynthia: Here, let me give you a
small gift.
Would you like to give
the Eevee a nickname?
Cynthia: The numerous possibilities of
evolution for Eevee make it a very
interesting Pokémon.
I wonder what you’ll decide
to evolve Eevee into...?
Cynthia: Perhaps we’ll cross paths
again, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}, but until then, farewell!
